about: (Noah) the Tablet of Mysteries' donated weapons (docs/TABLET_OF_MYSTERIES.md): worn = one tier above your class sword, battered = two; uses = hits / arrows / casts before it breaks; lost if you fall. model: the weapon's own (tools/tabletweapons.py; the fists have none - they are gloves, tools/tabletgloves.py); show: the model that rises out of the tablet's pool; gloves: the fists' gloves (first-person and third-person models).

rows.label: Stormtalons
rows.power: Glass claws. Every 3rd hit chains lightning to 2 more. Heavy: stuns.
rows.owner: Left by a storm-mage who fought with her hands when her magicka ran dry.

rows.label: Gravebell Mace
rows.power: Every 5th hit tolls the bell, stunning the dead within 5 m.
rows.owner: Taken from a ruined temple of Arkay.

rows.label: Talons of Woe
rows.power: Dragonbone claws. Bleed runs twice as deep; kills heal you a little.
rows.owner: Cut from the talons of a dragon that fell over Whiterun.

rows.label: Riverstone Halberd
rows.power: Hits knock the dead back. Heavy: splits the ground in a line ahead.
rows.owner: Dragged out of the White River.

rows.label: Wyrmspine Pike
rows.power: Thrusts pierce 2 more in a line. Heavy: a shockwave that staggers within 8 m.
rows.owner: Carved from the spine of the first dragon Alduin raised.

rows.label: Rimewick Quarterstaff
rows.power: Light: freezes for 3 s. Heavy: a blizzard, 10 m for 6 s.
rows.owner: Carried by a lamplighter of Riften until the lamps went out.

rows.label: Cinderclaws
rows.power: Every swipe sets the dead burning. Heavy: a fan of embers.
rows.owner: Pried from a dremora who walked out of an Oblivion gate.

rows.label: Eclipse Edge
rows.power: Hits alternate frost and sun. Heavy: an ice shockwave, then a sun shockwave (10 m).
rows.owner: Its last bearer saw the sun go out over Sky Haven.

rows.label: The Wandering Star
rows.power: Hold to cast: a gold star every 0.5 s that bounces to up to 4 nearby. Every 5th hit throws far.
rows.owner: Found at the bottom of the College's collapsed well.

look.plugin: Fulcimentum - More Staves and Wands of Skyrim.esp

rows.label: Frostmourn Rapier
rows.power: Thrusts slow. Heavy: freezes a ring of the dead around you.
rows.owner: Brought from Solstheim by a duellist of Raven Rock.

rows.label: Silver Reaping Scythe
rows.power: Every 4th hit: a silver flash that briefly slows the dead.
rows.owner: Left at the Hall of the Vigilant after it burned.

rows.label: Bonereaper
rows.power: 1 kill in 4 rises to fight for you for 20 s.
rows.owner: Dug out of a necromancer's grave outside Falkreath.

rows.label: Wyrmtooth Scythe
rows.power: Hits bleed. Heavy: a shockwave that staggers within 8 m.
rows.owner: Pulled from a dragon mound's bones.

rows.label: Bloodmoon Scythe
rows.power: Hits drain blood to heal you. Heavy: drains everything it touches.
rows.owner: Taken from a vampire lord who hunted the cursed for sport.
